name: oido-gmail
description: Send, receive, and search emails via IMAP/SMTP using MCP server. Authenticate with your own Google OAuth connection.

settings.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: Google OAuth client ID (from your Google Cloud project)

settings.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH
settings.description: Connect your Google account for Gmail IMAP/SMTP access

settings.name: GMAIL_ALLOW_ORGANIZE
settings.description: Change flags and labels, move to trash, and create, edit or discard drafts. All reversible and confined to the mailbox — does not permit sending.

settings.name: GMAIL_ALLOW_SEND
settings.description: Transmit email to recipients (send, reply, forward, send a draft). Irreversible and externally visible.

settings.name: GMAIL_ALLOW_RECEIVE
settings.description: Deprecated: previous name for GMAIL_ALLOW_READ. Still honoured for existing connections.
